Hearing this, the three emperors' eyes suddenly lit up, and they quickly stacked the three scrolls together and raised them in front of an oil lamp in the corner of the cave. Therefore, the Wei Mansion was set up in Yecheng, which was the center point of the entire Cao Wei Group, hoping to centralize power in Ye and control the country. Lin Qingxuan ran over and took the possessions of the Shengyuan Sect disciples. The flying sword, storage bag, etc. were all put away, and he returned to Shu Qingyu. He reached out and took off his storage bag. At this moment, the changes in the 12th-grade lotus platform finally caught the attention of Taoist Jie Yin. Taoist Jie Yin, who had been meditating with his eyes closed, suddenly opened his eyes, with a look of shock in his eyes. Therefore, he immediately asked Shen Gongbao for instructions. Shen Gongbao knew that he was not the leader. The general of the army, therefore, gave Lu Xiong full authority to command the army. Ao Hai did not allow Lin Qingxuan to say anything. He lifted up Lan Caiyi and Lin Qingxuan with one hand and flew towards the east at lightning speed. Zhou Yang was also riding a red rabbit horse with the Tiger Roaring Iron Spear behind him, but Ma Xiu pushed him aside intentionally or unintentionally, as if he was saying "Don't get too close to my father." He felt very embarrassed. Although he had the power, he knew Lin Xiaofeng's strength better than anyone else. If he really wanted to betray Lin Xiaofeng, Zhao Qianqian and Master Nima looked calm, and then they took out their brains with their own hands and put them into the skull bowl. So, when the boy was sobbing sadly, the quilt wrapped around the boy seemed to be alive and automatically let go of the boy.
